journey.observation: The pool is dominated by two things: Indian CII/industry waste-and-sustainability awards and Indian waste/recycling/AI trade expos. Most award entries are already dead for this cycle — CII 4R Awards (31 Jul 2026), CII-ITC Sustainability (22 May), CII Industrial Innovation (11 Sep, verified), CII Environmental Best Practices (18 Aug, verified), Automation Expo Founder Award (22 Jul, plus a post-1-Jan-2026 launch requirement) and WRETC (31 May, event already past). Only one result carries a verified deadline inside the next 14 days: the WRAFA awards nomination closing 25 Sep 2026. The remainder split into (a) live awards open to companies/MSMEs whose extracts show only a 2026/2027 edition but no closed date, and (b) exhibition pages for waste, recycling, plastics and AI expos with verified 2026–2027 dates. No grant, hackathon or student-only competition survived, and nothing evidenced a passed state except the CII/WRETC/Automation items.

picked.title: Awards & Recognition - World Robotics & Automation Fair (WRAFA)
picked.reason: Open to 'any organization / entrepreneur / allied sector offering AI or using AI' — a registered private company using AI qualifies. Carries a verified entry deadline of 25 Sep 2026, inside 14 days, and the questionnaire closes 30 Sep, so the edition is still live. It is a recognition award (the kind sought first), in an AI/automation technical space.

picked.title: Greenpreneur 2026
picked.reason: MSME awards explicitly open to micro, small and medium businesses, with tracks including Waste Management, Circular Economy, Sustainable MSME, Social Impact MSME and Tech-Driven MSME of the Year (AI/IoT) — an exact fit for a DPIIT/MSME waste-tech company; the 2026 edition page shows no closed date.

picked.title: BW Sustainable World Awards 2026 - BW Businessworld
picked.reason: Nominations open to 'Startups & MSMEs with sustainability-driven innovations' and 'Tech & AI companies enabling climate, energy, or social impact', plus a Green Tech Startup of the Year category; run by BW Businessworld as a single India awards programme for the 2026 conclave, no deadline shown as passed.

picked.title: Golden Peacock Global Award for ESG 2026, India
picked.reason: Run by the Golden Peacock Awards Secretariat (Institute of Directors), inviting applications from organisations for the 2026 India edition of an ESG recognition award; entrants are companies, not individuals or students, and no entry date is stated as closed.

picked.title: Global ESG Awards
picked.reason: India Edition of an international recognition award open to 'Corporates (large, mid-sized, and emerging)', 'Startups and innovators' and other organisations — a registered company qualifies; no winners or closing date shown for the India edition.

picked.title: (no title)
picked.reason: W2W India Expo (w2wiexpo.in) exhibition and summit, 17–19 December 2026 at India Expo Mart, Greater Noida; the organiser invites manufacturers, solution providers and technology companies to book a booth in solid waste management, recycling and circular economy — an exhibiting venue for a waste-tech company.

picked.title: RACE 2026: India’s Recycling And Compounding Expo
picked.reason: Exhibition open to recycling technology, equipment and solution companies; verified event date 16 December 2026 at BEC, NESCO Mumbai, so the edition is still ahead. It is a trade exhibition where a reverse-vending/DRS hardware company can take a stand.

picked.title: Waste Technology India Expo - Clean India Show
picked.reason: Messe Frankfurt India's waste management and recycling expo, 17–19 March 2027 Mumbai; the 'Why exhibit?' section invites product suppliers and solution providers in waste, recycling and circular economy to exhibit — a direct exhibiting venue, with the edition still ahead.
